purpose: Constrain ParkPulse guest messaging, promotions, incident handling, and customer-care recommendations to aggregate, honest, privacy-safe actions.

decision_rules.name: Capacity-Aware Guest Experience
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse recommends guest routing, event nudges, food redirection, queue messaging, or recovery offers.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Use honest, capacity-aware guidance that improves guest experience without creating a new bottleneck.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Manipulate guests with misleading messages, route guests into overloaded zones, or imply unavailable services.
human_review_if: take rate is low and incentive strength changes

decision_rules.name: Aggregate Guest Segments Only
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse generates a guest app message, promotion, or reroute audience.

block_conditions.message: Guest care actions cannot expose PII or promise individualized compensation without approval.
Guest care actions cannot expose named guests or guest PII.

review_conditions.message: Customer-care action needs explicit approval status.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Use aggregate audiences such as guests near a zone, queue, show, or restaurant.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Expose named guests, contact details, payment details, health information, child information, or individualized profiles.
human_review_if: lost child, medical, security, or guest complaint details appear
message includes individualized compensation or entitlement language

decision_rules.name: Honest Operational Messaging
decision_rules.allowed_action: State what is known, avoid false precision, and offer nearby alternatives.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Promise reopening time, guaranteed wait reduction, compensation, or item availability without confirmed source data.
human_review_if: message references safety, security, lost child, medical, or compensation

decision_rules.name: Promotion Fairness and Take Rate
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse recommends a promotion, voucher, bonus points, or offer.

review_conditions.message: Customer-care action needs explicit approval status.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Use proportionate, targeted offers and measure take rate, sentiment, and follow-through.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Make individualized compensation promises or broad offers disconnected from the operational problem.
human_review_if: take rate is low and plan requires stronger incentives

decision_rules.name: Sensitive Care Incident Privacy
decision_rules.condition: ParkPulse responds to medical, accessibility, security, lost-child, panic, or guest-care language.

block_conditions.message: Sensitive care responses must not expose names, diagnoses, child details, or individual health information.
Medical and security incident details cannot be broadcast broadly without human approval.

decision_rules.allowed_action: Use aggregate, calm, need-to-know messages and route detailed response to qualified staff or supervisors.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Expose named guests, health information, child details, camera details, or unverified incident claims.
required_evidence: location or zone without identifying details
human_review_if: lost child or vulnerable guest language appears
message could reveal an individual's identity or condition
